name: Dark High Contrast
source: VS Code 1.133.0: extensions/theme-defaults/themes/hc_black.json, then the colour registry defaults (hcDark) of out/vs/workbench/workbench.desktop.main.js, resolved: contrastBorder #6FC3DF, contrastActiveBorder = focusBorder #F38518, transparent(x, a) as alpha. Code - OSS, MIT. Keys VS Code leaves null in hcDark are absent here; their roles are in `tokens` with the reason in `notes`.

notes.shadow-color: widget.shadow and scrollbar.shadow are null in hcDark: High Contrast has no shadows (DESIGN.md R7).
notes.button-border: button.border has no registry default; HC buttons are outlined with contrastBorder.
notes.button2-hover: button.secondaryHoverBackground, toolbar.*Background, list.dropBackground and menu.selectionBackground are null in hcDark (VS Code outlines them with contrastActiveBorder instead); derived from list.hoverBackground so egui's hovered state still shows (DS3 adds the outlines).
notes.list-sel: list.activeSelectionBackground and list.inactiveSelectionBackground are null in hcDark: selection shows by the list.focusOutline outline.
notes.selection: hc_black.json sets editor.selectionBackground #FFFFFF with selectionForeground #000000; egui cannot recolour selected text by background, so the role keeps the registry's #F3F518.
notes.tab-bg: tab.inactiveBackground and tab.activeBackground are unset in hcDark: the editor background.
notes.tab-active-marker: tab.activeBorderTop is null in hcDark; contrastActiveBorder.
notes.elev-0: No shadows in High Contrast (DESIGN.md §2.5, R7).
notes.toggle-on-bg: POL1-STATES: inputOption.activeBackground is transparent and inputOption.activeBorder equals contrastBorder in High Contrast, so an on toggle (checked toggle button, checkbox, radio; a selected button) would look off. R17: the on state is a fill (toolbar-active's tint) with contrastActiveBorder's edge.
